response.text: {"name":"Skica in letnice","idea":"Every Lesnik piece begins as a drawing made together at the client's table and ends as oak, walnut or larch from the Poljanska dolina sawmills, so the page is a joiner's working sheet: dimension lines measure the type, and woodcut-printed end-grain cross-sections of the three woods are the only pictures.","palette":[{"role":"background","hex":"#f2f4f1"},{"role":"text","hex":"#1f1a16"},{"role":"muted","hex":"#55524c"},{"role":"primary","hex":"#8a3b1e"},{"role":"onPrimary","hex":"#f4f1ec"},{"role":"inverse","hex":"#2a1f18"},{"role":"onInverse","hex":"#eee8df"},{"role":"accent","hex":"#d08a45"},{"role":"border","hex":"#c3c8c1"}],"pairing":"fraunces-source-sans","typeCharacter":"Fraunces in its heavy, soft-cornered optical display weight feels carved and warm without being nostalgic; it sets the h1 very large (about 8vw) in sentence case and the section titles at 48 to 64 px, always upright, while Source Sans 3 carries the leads at 20 px, the body at 17 px and the cutting-list rows at 22 px semibold, all sentence case with no tracking tricks.","composition":"Hero on the cool light tint #f2f4f1: columns 1 to 7 hold the h1 in Fraunces heavy #1f1a16 across three lines, with a thin #1f1a16 drafting dimension line (short end ticks, small arrowheads, no numbers) running exactly the width of the first line just above it; below, the lead in Source Sans at 6 columns and one rectangular rust #8a3b1e button with square corners.
